 from openlibrary.core import cache
 
 
+def get_isbn_10_and_13(isbns: str | list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Separate IA ISBNs by length, discarding values without an ISBN format."""
+    isbn_10, isbn_13 = [], []
+    for value in [isbns] if isinstance(isbns, str) else (isbns or []):
+        if not isinstance(value, str):
+            continue
+        isbn = re.sub(r'[\s-]+', '', value).upper()
+        if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{9}[0-9X]', isbn):
+            isbn_10.append(isbn)
+        elif re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{13}', isbn):
+            isbn_13.append(isbn)
+    return isbn_10, isbn_13
+
+
+def get_publisher_and_place(
+    publishers: str | list[str],
+) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Split IA's ``Place : Publisher`` values into edition fields."""
+    names, places = [], []
+    for value in [publishers] if isinstance(publishers, str) else (publishers or []):
+        if not isinstance(value, str):
+            continue
+        value = value.strip()
+        if not value:
+            continue
+        if ':' in value:
+            place, name = (part.strip() for part in value.split(':', 1))
+            if name:
+                names.append(name)
+                if place:
+                    places.append(place)
+        else:
+            names.append(value)
+    return names, places
+
+
 class LanguageMultipleMatchError(Exception):
     """Exception raised when more than one possible language match is found."""
